description: This file defines the API routes for managing game lobbies in a multiplayer game backend using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, joining, leaving, setting readiness, and matchmaking into lobbies. It handles lobby data retrieval, user interactions, and lobby state changes.

classes.name: LobbyPublic
classes.description: Schema representing the public view of a lobby, including its metadata and list of players.

classes.name: LobbyPlayer
classes.description: Schema representing a player within a lobby, including user info and status.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Schema for basic user information shown publicly.

classes.name: MessageResponse
classes.description: Schema for simple message responses from endpoints.

classes.name: LobbyCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for the data required to create a new lobby.

classes.name: LobbyJoinRequest
classes.description: Schema for the data required to join a lobby by code.

classes.name: MatchmakeRequest
classes.description: Schema for parameters to find or create a lobby during matchmaking.

methods.name: str _generate_code()
methods.description: Generates a 6-character string consisting of uppercase letters and digits to be used as a unique lobby code.

methods.name: LobbyPublic _get_lobby_with_players(conn, lobby_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches comprehensive lobby info along with the list of players and their details based on lobby ID.

methods.name: list_lobbies()
methods.description: Returns a list of currently open, public lobbies.

methods.name: create_lobby(payload: LobbyCreateRequest, claims=Depends(get_current_user_claims))
methods.description: Creates a new lobby hosted by the current user and adds the host as the first player.

methods.name: join_lobby(payload: LobbyJoinRequest, claims=Depends(get_current_user_claims))
methods.description: Allows a user to join an existing lobby using a lobby code.

methods.name: leave_lobby(lobby_id: str, claims=Depends(get_current_user_claims))
methods.description: Allows a user to leave a lobby; if the user is the host, the lobby is closed.

methods.name: ready_up(lobby_id: str, claims=Depends(get_current_user_claims))
methods.description: Marks the current user as ready in the lobby, potentially triggering game start conditions.

methods.name: matchmake(payload: MatchmakeRequest, claims=Depends(get_current_user_claims))
methods.description: Matches the user into an existing open lobby with available slots or creates a new one.
